component.name: I Have Issues
component.summary: A document-based issue tracker for small projects

description.p: I Have Issues keeps a project's bugs, features, tasks and questions in a single .issues file that lives beside the code and is committed to the same repository. The file is plain JSON, written so that it diffs cleanly in git.

ul.li: type, priority, status and, once closed, a resolution reason
who reported it and when, the area it affects, labels, assignees, a milestone and an estimate
a description, steps to reproduce, environment, investigation notes and the resolution
comments, relations to other entries, and links to remote trackers

description.p: Issues can be pushed to a GitHub repository. The personal access token is kept in the system keyring and is never written into the document, because those files are committed and shared.
The same .issues files are read and written by the Apple, Android and Haiku versions of this application.
